passages.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He told them not to let their hearts be troubled.
He said, “You believe in God.
Believe in Me also.”
passages.original: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν Θεόν καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε

passages.text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
God is the Father.
God’s house has many rooms.
These rooms are in heaven.
Jesus said this is true.
Jesus said, “I am going to prepare a place for you.”
If this were not true, Jesus would not have told them.
Jesus promised to prepare a place for His followers.
passages.original: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ Πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν εἰ δὲ μή εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν

passages.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said He would go and prepare a place for them.
If Jesus goes and prepares a place, He will return.
Jesus will come back for His disciples.
Jesus will welcome His disciples to Himself.
Jesus wants His disciples to be with Him.
Where Jesus is, His disciples will also be.
passages.original: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε

passages.text: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to His disciples.\r\nJesus said He was going to His Father.\r\nJesus said, “You know the way to where I am going.”
passages.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν

passages.text: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
passages.sermon:
Thomas spoke to Jesus.
Thomas called Jesus “Lord.”
Thomas said, “We do not know where you are going.”
Thomas asked, “How can we know the way?”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς Κύριε οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις πῶς δυνάμεθα τὴν ὁδὸν εἰδέναι

passages.text: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Thomas.
Jesus said, “I am the way.
I am the truth.
I am the life.
No one comes to the Father except through Me.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα εἰ μὴ δι’ ἐμοῦ

passages.text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus said, “If you had known Me, you would know My Father also.”
Now you know the Father.
Now you have seen the Father.”
passages.original: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε ἀπ’ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε αὐτόν

passages.text: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
passages.sermon:
Philip spoke to Jesus.
Philip called Jesus “Lord.”
Philip said, “Show us the Father.”
Philip said, “That will be enough for us.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος Κύριε δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν

passages.text: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Philip.
Jesus had been with Philip and the other disciples for a long time.
Jesus asked Philip why Philip did not know Him after all this time.
Jesus said that anyone who has seen Him has seen the Father.
Jesus asked Philip how Philip could say, "Show us the Father."
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με Φίλιππε ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα πῶς σὺ λέγεις Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα

passages.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Philip.
Jesus said, "Do you not believe that I am in the Father?
The Father is in Me.
The words I say to you are not from Myself.
I do not speak on My own.
The Father lives in Me.
The Father does His works through Me."
passages.original: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ ὁ δὲ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “Believe Me.
I am in the Father.
The Father is in Me.
If you do not believe My words, look at My works.
Believe because of the works themselves.”
passages.original: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί εἰ δὲ μή διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ πιστεύετε

passages.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus says, “I tell you the truth.”
Anyone who believes in Jesus will do the works that Jesus does.
Anyone who believes in Jesus will do even greater works than these.
Jesus will go to the Father.
passages.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα πορεύομαι

passages.text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son.
The Father is God.
Jesus speaks to His followers.
Jesus says, “If you ask for anything in My name, I will do it.”
I will do this so that the Father will be glorified in the Son.
passages.original: καὶ ὅ¦τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ

passages.text: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
If you ask Jesus for anything in His name, He will do it.
You must ask in the name of Jesus.
Jesus Himself will act.
passages.original: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐγὼ ποιήσω

passages.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to His disciples.
Jesus says, "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments."
Loving Jesus means obeying what He commands.
Obedience shows true love for Jesus.
passages.original: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς τηρήσετε

passages.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever— the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said He would ask the Father.
The Father will give you another Advocate.
This Advocate will be with you forever.
This Advocate is the Spirit of truth.
The world cannot receive the Spirit of truth.
The world does not see Him.
The world does not know Him.
You know the Spirit of truth.
He remains with you.
He will be in you.
passages.original: Κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον Παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ᾖ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό ὅτι παρ’ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται

passages.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to His disciples.
Jesus promises not to leave His disciples alone.
Jesus says, “I will not leave you as orphans.”
Jesus says, “I will come to you.”
passages.original: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς

passages.text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He said He would soon be gone from the world.
In a little while, the world will not see Jesus anymore.
But the disciples will see Jesus.
Jesus lives.
Because Jesus lives, the disciples will also live.
passages.original: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ζήσετε

passages.text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “On that day, you will know something important.
You will know that I am in My Father.
You will know that you are in Me.
You will know that I am in you.”
passages.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν

passages.text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus gave commandments to His followers.
A person who has Jesus’ commandments and keeps them shows love for Jesus.
This person loves Jesus.
The Father will love this person.
Jesus will also love this person.
Jesus will reveal Himself to this person.
passages.original: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν

passages.text: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
passages.sermon:
Judas spoke to Jesus.
This Judas was not Iscariot.
Judas called Jesus “Lord.”
Judas asked Jesus a question.
Judas said, “Why will You reveal Yourself to us?”
Judas also said, “Why will You not reveal Yourself to the world?”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης Κύριε καὶ τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ

passages.text: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Judas (not Iscariot).
Jesus answered him.
If anyone loves Jesus, he will obey Jesus’ word.
God the Father will love that person.
Jesus and the Father will come to that person.
Jesus and the Father will make their home with that person.
passages.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει καὶ ὁ Πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρ’ αὐτῷ ποιησόμεθα

passages.text: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
The Father sent Jesus.
Anyone who does not love Jesus does not keep His words.
The words the disciples hear are not from Jesus alone.
These words come from the Father who sent Jesus.
passages.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με Πατρός

passages.text: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
passages.sermon: Jesus is speaking to His disciples.\r\nJesus is still present with them.\r\nJesus has said all these things to them while He is with them.
passages.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρ’ ὑμῖν μένων

passages.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
passages.sermon:
The Father will send the Holy Spirit.
The Father will send the Holy Spirit in My name.
The Holy Spirit is the Advocate.
The Holy Spirit will teach you all things.
The Holy Spirit will remind you of everything I have told you.
passages.original: ὁ δὲ Παράκλητος τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ὑμῖν ἐγώ

passages.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to His disciples.
Jesus gives them peace.
Jesus leaves His peace with them.
This peace belongs to Jesus.
Jesus gives this peace to them.
The world gives peace in a different way.
Jesus does not give peace as the world gives.
Jesus tells them not to let their hearts be troubled.
Jesus tells them not to be afraid.
passages.original: Εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω

passages.text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “I am going away.”
Jesus also said, “I am coming back to you.”
You heard Me say these things.
If you loved Me, you would rejoice.
I am going to the Father.
The Father is greater than I am.
passages.original: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν

passages.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to His disciples.\r\nJesus told them what would happen before it happened.\r\nHe did this so they would believe when it happened.
passages.original: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε

passages.text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to His disciples.
Jesus says, “I will not speak with you much longer.”
The prince of this world is coming.
The prince of this world has no claim on Me.
passages.original: Οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν

passages.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to His disciples.
Jesus obeys the Father.
Jesus does everything the Father commands Him.
Jesus wants the world to know that He loves the Father.
Jesus says, “Get up!”
Jesus says, “Let us go from here.”
passages.original: ἀλλ’ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ καθὼς ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ Πατὴρ οὕτως ποιῶ Ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν
